name: security-recipes.ai
tagline: Turn CVE intelligence into verified, evidence-backed remediation teams can trust.
description: Open, self-hostable knowledge layer linking source-backed CVE research to bounded remediation recipes, required evidence, rollback guidance, and human-reviewed outcomes—built for teams that need traceable action, not another alert stream.

name: OSS Dependency Explorer
tagline: Map multi-ecosystem dependencies and surface supply-chain risk before production.
description: Supply-chain research tool that maps package dependencies across eight ecosystems and combines vulnerability, repository health, license, and SBOM analysis—so security and engineering leaders can triage risk before it ships.

name: Shiba Studio
tagline: Local-first studio to build, govern, and audit production-ready AI agents.
description: Unifies agent orchestration, workspace-aware coding, browser control, scheduling, integrations, memory, and auditable local workflows—so organizations automate with AI without surrendering data control or auditability.

name: Pro Response
tagline: Raise message quality with AI inside Slack and the channels teams already use.
description: Multi-provider writing assistant that rewrites, translates, summarizes, and reformats messages via Slack, HTTP API, CLI, or Python—clearer enterprise communication without pulling people out of existing workflows.

name: Spare Cycles
tagline: Route inference across volunteer nodes behind an OpenAI-compatible proxy.
description: Open research experiment that pools volunteer capacity running Claude, GPT, Grok, or Ollama, with a marketplace of coding projects—MIT-licensed pooled compute for experimentation, not a managed enterprise service.

name: Tiny Book Buddies AI
tagline: Turn one bedtime idea into an illustrated, narrated children's storybook.
description: Browser-based story studio that writes, illustrates, narrates, and exports children's books with user-selected AI providers—end-to-end in the browser, built as a consumer product experiment.

name: mouseclicker.app
tagline: Portable Windows auto-clicker with record/replay and optional AI patterns.
description: Lightweight Windows automation utility with humanized cursor movement, global hotkeys, system-wide record/replay, and optional cloud or local AI pattern generation—no installer required.

name: DOGE Commerce Kit
tagline: Non-custodial toolkit for accepting Dogecoin in person or online.
description: Commerce utilities for small sellers: browser wallet tools, point-of-sale checkout, payment QR codes, on-chain verification, a local order ledger, and embeddable site components—no processor custody.

name: Arrowhead Paesano
tagline: Static fan site with an automated weekly game-preview desk.
description: Site for the Arrowhead Paesano YouTube channel: privacy-friendly playback from a checked-in snapshot, plus a sourced weekly Chiefs preview with matchups, projections, and a ready-to-shoot run-of-show.

name: Desert Wander Supply Co.
tagline: Southwest outdoor gear storefront for desert travel and everyday carry.
description: Hosted storefront for desert exploration gear spanning apparel, outdoor accessories, and pet gear, with a merchandised catalog, checkout, and customer email capture.

name: DOGE MINER
tagline: Scrypt pool mining with a live dashboard and hardware telemetry.
description: Full-stack Dogecoin pool miner for CPU and OpenCL GPUs, with live pool responses, share statistics, hardware telemetry, and on-chain wallet data—transparent hobby mining, not enterprise infrastructure.
